text:
- **Owner questions and replies:** Agent questions now appear on the site with their options. The first answer, from the site or from chat, is used. Owner replies now reach a session by push, and the wait command and inbox hook are removed.
- **Agent guidance file:** AGENTS.md is now a short map that Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build read in full. Each pull request now runs an agent check on it, signed in without a stored API key.
- **Test and CI speed:** Pull requests now run only the Go test packages that their changed files can affect. Go test compute on macOS fell for each pull request, and main still runs all Go tests on macOS.
- **Benchmark study:** A new project opened to measure whether pm helps long-horizon agent tasks on public benchmarks. A survey of candidate benchmarks was written, and the first benchmark choice was raised to the owner.
